assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Reinstating the regression (removing the exit-record fold from local_liveness) makes process_alive read True again, as logs/negative_control.log shows reddening exactly this line.
Removing the exit-unfinished classification of a dead worker with committed work and an in-progress manifest, or reaching the arm by another route, reddens the classification and the snapshot state.
Ending a run whose worker record's pid is alive, or ending a resumed attempt on its predecessor's exit record, changes the running reading these two controls assert.
